jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
About The Role

Senior Software Developer

📍Location: Gorinchem, Netherlands (Hybrid)
Industry: Software Development / Industrial Technology / Technology Solutions
Job Function: Software Engineering / Software Development

Employment Type: Full-Time

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer to join a highly technical and collaborative engineering team based in Gorinchem on a Hybrid basis. This is an opportunity to work on complex software systems where modern cloud-native technologies intersect with existing enterprise, embedded, and industrial software environments.

The successful candidate will play a key role in designing scalable architectures, modernising existing systems, and delivering robust software solutions that support long-term business objectives. You will work in an Agile Scrum environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams while contributing to architectural decisions, technical strategy, and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position is ideal for a software engineer who thrives in complexity, enjoys solving challenging technical problems, and can balance innovation with the realities of existing software landscapes. You will have the opportunity to influence technical direction, mentor others through best practices, and help shape future-proof solutions within a highly structured engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design and evolve scalable software architectures that support long-term maintainability and technical sustainability.
Develop and maintain backend and full-stack software solutions using Microsoft technologies and modern development frameworks.
Work within complex software environments, including legacy systems, enterprise applications, and embedded software components.
Build, maintain, and optimise APIs and system integrations across distributed environments.
Contribute to software modernisation initiatives, including migration projects involving .NET Core and modern .NET architectures.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to define technical solutions and implementation strategies.
Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure software quality, performance, scalability, and security through best engineering practices.
Support architectural decision-making and provide technical guidance on complex development projects.
Identify opportunities to improve system performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Your Profile

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Proven experience as a Senior Software Developer or Senior Software Engineer working on complex software systems.
Strong expertise in C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET technologies.
Experience designing and delivering scalable, maintainable backend solutions.
Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
Experience working within Agile Scrum development environments.
Ability to work effectively within both modern and legacy software landscapes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for software delivery.
Fluent in both English and Dutch.

Preferred Experience

.NET Core, .NET 6, .NET 8, or later versions.
Cloud-native application development.
API development and systems integration.
Enterprise software development.
Embedded or industrial software environments.
Distributed systems and microservices architectures.
Software modernisation and migration projects.
Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Long-term career development and progression opportunities.
Supportive team culture with opportunities to contribute to technical strategy and decision-making.

Apply today or contact Arthur Mahoney for more information about this opportunity.

jobs.title: .NET Engineer
jobs.description:
Wat je gaat doen

Ben jij een senior .NET Engineer
die méér wil dan standaardwerk? Wil je werken aan uitdagende
, impactvolle projecten, waar jij vanaf het eerste strategische idee tot de optimalisatie
een sleutelrol speelt? Dan is iO dé plek voor jou.

Bij iO werk je niet zomaar aan applicaties. Jij helpt grote namen zoals Landal GreenParks, Enexis en Efteling
om hun digitale uitdagingen op te lossen. Hoe zorgen we voor meer boekingen? Hoe kunnen we AI inzetten om de klantenservice te verbeteren? Jij denkt verder dan code – jij bouwt slimme oplossingen die écht impact maken. En dat doe je niet door simpelweg code te schrijven en door te gaan naar het volgende project? Nee, bij iO ben je onderdeel van het hele proces: van de eerste strategische sessies tot de oplevering én de doorontwikkeling.

En dat betekent:

✔ Vanaf dag één betrokken zijn bij de strategie en architectuur.

✔ Werken aan high-performance applicaties
met de nieuwste .NET-technologieën.

✔ Code controleren op consistentie, complexiteit en schaalbaarheid.

✔ Samenwerken in een multidisciplinair team
met designers, strategen en marketeers. Kennisdeling staat centraal en samen met jouw team bepaal jij de route.

✔ Jouw eigen pad bepalen – dedicated werken voor één klant of juist variatie in projecten. Wij stemmen projecten af op jouw ambities.

✔ Geen repetitief werk
– elke uitdaging is anders en vraagt om een unieke aanpak.

✔ Ruimte voor groei
– Expert Groups, certificeringen en inspirerende events.

Wil jij bouwen aan digitale oplossingen die écht het verschil maken? Neem contact met ons op
en ontdek hoe jij je bij iO kunt ontwikkelen! 🚀

Daarom ben jij de perfecte .NET Engineer

✔ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met .NET
en een stevige kennis van design patterns.

✔ Ervaring met Sitecore, Umbraco of Optimizely
is een plus, interesse is een must.

✔ Je overziet de volledige architectuur
en maakt doordachte technische keuzes.

✔ Agile mindset
– je hebt eerder gewerkt met Scrum en weet hoe je in een team impact maakt.

✔ Je communiceert helder en spreekt en schrijft foutloos Nederlands.

Dit krijg jij van ons

25 vakantiedagen

Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.

Reiskosten & vakantiegeld

Uiteraard kun je rekenen op 8% vakantiegeld. Daarnaast hebben we verschillende mobiliteitsregelingen, maar afhankelijk van jouw functie en voorkeur een keuze.

Goede pensioenregeling

Jij legt 4% in en iO vult de rest aan tot de volledige premie.

Hybride werken

Een goede werk- en privébalans is superbelangrijk. Samen met jouw team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch

Op iedere iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en kun je tegen een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd lunchen.

Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget

Zet jaarlijks € 3.000,- in om jezelf te ontwikkelen, in je vak of als persoon, met trainingen, events of cursussen.

Milestones & celebrations

En bovenal zijn we bij iO ook gewoon een gezellige club mensen, al zeggen we het zelf. Het Fun & Party-team op jouw campus staat op z'n tijd dan ook garant voor de leukste feestjes.

Ons Mobile ontwikkelteam zoekt een fanatieke Mobile App Developer. Ben jij creatief en heb je passie voor het ontwikkelen van apps? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

ChipSoft heeft al diverse apps uitgebracht en het aantal gebruikers hiervan neemt snel toe. De apps doen het erg goed bij de zorginstellingen. Je kunt hierbij denken aan apps verpleegkundigen, thuiszorgmedewerkers, de logistieke dienst en - natuurlijk - de artsen zelf. Door jouw hands-on mentaliteit, eigenwijsheid en technisch inzicht kun je nauwkeurig herbruikbare software schrijven. Die software sluit naadloos aan op onze ‘back end’ (HiX, onze ICT-totaaloplossing voor de zorg). Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van apps. Dit doe je met de nieuwste versie van Visual Studio voor IOS, Android en UWP.

ChipSoft heeft al diverse apps uitgebracht en het aantal gebruikers hiervan neemt snel toe. De apps doen het erg goed bij de zorginstellingen. Van een goed salaris tot gezellige borrels en van volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden tot dagelijks genieten in ons eigen ChipCafé. Wij zorgen ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier en energie kunt doen.

jobs.location: Mülheim an der Ruhr, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
jobs.description:
Description

Über INPLAN

INPLAN entwickelt seit über 30 Jahren Standardsoftware für Häfen, Terminalbetreiber und Logistikdienstleister sowie für Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsprozesse (Source-to-Pay). Unsere Lösungen steuern geschäftskritische Abläufe an mehr als 50 Standorten in Deutschland und Europa. Als Teil der internationalen Valsoft Corporation verbinden wir die Stabilität eines Konzerns mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Die Rolle

Sie entwickeln unsere Produkte weiter – und Sie sprechen dabei direkt mit den Menschen, die damit arbeiten. Das unterscheidet diese Position von einer reinen Entwicklerrolle: Sie nehmen Anforderungen selbst beim Kunden auf und begleiten Ihre Lösung bis zur Abnahme.

Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung. Der Kundenanteil macht die Arbeit greifbar – Sie sehen unmittelbar, was Ihre Arbeit im Betrieb bewirkt.

Ihre Aufgaben

Entwicklung

Weiterentwicklung unserer produktiven .NET-Anwendungen: neue Funktionen, technische Optimierung, Performance
Umsetzung von Änderungswünschen und Neuentwicklungen in enger Abstimmung mit Projektleitung und Professional Services
Entwurf technischer Lösungen einschließlich Aufwandsschätzung
Entwicklung und Pflege von Schnittstellen: REST und SOAP, XML- und Datei-Import/-Export
Datenbanknahe Arbeit mit Oracle und MS SQL Server – Abfragen, Views, Stored Procedures
Code Reviews, technische Dokumentation, Release- und Deployment-Prozesse

Kundenprojekte

Anforderungen gemeinsam mit dem Kunden aufnehmen und präzisieren
Änderungswünsche fachlich und technisch spezifizieren, Aufwände einschätzen und im Kundengespräch vertreten
Abstimmungstermine und Produktdemos eigenständig führen, per Video-Call oder vor Ort
Ergebnisse verständlich zurückspiegeln

Optional

Mitgestaltung unserer KI- und Automatisierungsthemen, im Produkt wie in der täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit

Requirements

Voraussetzungen

Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau in Wort und Schrift. Unsere Kunden kommunizieren auf Deutsch – schriftlich wie im Gespräch.
Wohnort im Umkreis von maximal 60 km um Mülheim an der Ruhr. Regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort gehört zur Rolle.
Gute Kenntnisse in C# oder VB.NET. Unsere Systeme laufen auf VB.NET. Wenn Sie aus der C#-Welt kommen, unterstützen wir den Einstieg – die .NET-Grundlagen sind dieselben.
Sicheres Auftreten im Kundengespräch.

Ihr fachlicher Hintergrund

Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung im Unternehmensumfeld
Gute Kenntnisse in .NET, in C# und/oder VB.NET
Erfahrung mit umfangreichen, produktiv eingesetzten Anwendungen
Gute SQL-Kenntnisse in Oracle und/oder MS SQL Server
Solide Web- und Integrationsgrundlagen: ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, XML
Gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Valsoft-Gruppe

Von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit DevExpress, jQuery oder vergleichbaren UI-Frameworks
Praktische Nutzung von KI-Werkzeugen in der Entwicklung
Erfahrung mit Logistik-, Hafen-, ERP- oder Beschaffungssoftware
Routine im Umgang mit Jira und Confluence

Benefits

Was wir bieten

Produkte, die bei namhaften Kunden im geschäftskritischen Einsatz laufen
Direkter Kundenkontakt und sichtbare Wirkung Ihrer Arbeit
Kurze Entscheidungswege und Eigenverantwortung ab dem ersten Tag
Hybrides Arbeiten mit festem Standort in Mülheim an der Ruhr
Weiterbildung, unter anderem zu aktuellen KI-Themen
Langfristige Perspektive in einem etablierten Unternehmen mit internationaler Konzernstruktur

jobs.description:
Tiere. Technologie. Zukunft

Sano steht für nachhaltige Tierernährung – von Mineralfutter und Kälbermilch bis zu Spezialprodukten für Rinder und Schweine. Unser Produktportfolio ist so vielfältig wie die Landwirtschaft selbst. Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines Familienunternehmens mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Ein Unternehmen, das seit Jahrzehnten weiß, worauf es ankommt: gesunde Tiere, nachhaltige Prozesse – und IT, die das möglich macht.

Was dich erwartet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein Team mit echtem Antrieb und eine Branche, die Nachhaltigkeit nicht nur predigt, sondern lebt.

Hier bist du gefragt - deine Aufgaben

Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) technische Verantwortung für unsere Plattform übernehmen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie unsere Software in Zukunft aufgebaut ist.
Sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team spannende Lösungen erarbeiten, die bereits heute in der Landwirtschaft eingesetzt und von dir kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
Mit deinem Gespür für den richtigen Code Struktur in komplexe Systeme bringen, unsere Cloud-Plattform gestalten und dabei die langfristige Tragfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im Blick behalten.
Standards, Schnittstellen und technische Leitplanken definieren, neue Technologien bewerten und fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
Mit deinem Blick für das Wesentliche moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices oder API-basierte Systeme sinnvoll einbringen.
Last, but not least beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps- und CI/CD-Strukturen supporten.

Das bringst du mit – dein Profil

Idealerweise eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug – was zählt: Du brennst für IT und Softwarearchitektur
Ein Muss: Berufspraxis als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d), Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Lead Developer (m/w/d)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET (Core/6/7/8)
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen (Microservices, Event-Driven, API-Design, Messaging) sowie fundiertes Know-how in Security-Konzepten
Erfahrung in Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud), in Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in Datenplattformen, Datenbanken sowie IoT-Architekturen
Kenntnisse in DevOps, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Bicep, GitOps) sowie Expertise im Monitoring, Logging und Tracing Spaß daran, technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und in (komplexen) Architekturen zu denken

Deine Vorteile bei Sano

Gute Arbeit, guter Verdienst: attraktives Gehaltspaket
Werkzeug, das begeistert: moderne Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsalltag
Zeit für dich: 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr
Beruf trifft Leben: Flexible Modelle zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf – damit wir dich in jeder Lebensphase begleiten
Hier bist du richtig: ein zukunftssicheres Umfeld, das auf dich wartet
Rundum gut versorgt: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Krankenzusatzversicherung & betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Sattel auf, Zukunft an: Business Bike
Gemeinsam mehr erleben: besondere Teamevents, die verbinden
Kleine Aufmerksamkeiten, große Wirkung: spannende Mitarbeitergeschenke
Wissen, das wächst: die Sano Akademie – dein Ort für Entwicklung und Weiterbildung

"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.

Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.

A hands-on building role: taking AI features from idea to shipped, working software quickly, inside real products that real businesses depend on. You design prompts, manage context, integrate models, build evaluations and handle the plumbing and the polish – all of it.

Crucially, most of this work happens in established C# .NET codebases, not greenfield projects. Klipboard's products have been earning their keep for years, and the job is landing modern AI capability inside them cleanly, without breaking what already works. Fast matters here, but fast with evidence – every AI feature needs evaluation behind it before customers see it. We would rather you shipped something measured and honest this sprint than something perfect next quarter.

Key Responsibilities

Role Accountabilities

Build AI features quickly and properly – from prompts and context design through to full LLM integration in established C# .NET codebases.
Make them production-grade – error handling, fallbacks, latency management, logging, monitoring and solid evaluation before anything reaches a customer.
Stay sharp and share as you go – keeping up with a fast-moving space and spreading knowledge through code, examples and conversation.

Key Activities and Contributions

Design and build prompts, context strategies and LLM integrations for product features, in domains where a confidently wrong price, part match or stock answer is worse than no answer.
Work primarily in C# .NET, integrating AI capability into established codebases through clean service boundaries, sensible abstractions and respect for the code that is already there.
Move fast on real deadlines – prototype in days, harden in weeks, and know the difference between a corner that can be cut and one that cannot.
Build evaluation alongside the feature, not after it – test against real business cases, measure quality honestly, and let the numbers settle arguments.
Handle the unglamorous parts well: error handling, fallbacks when a model misbehaves, latency, token cost, logging and monitoring.
Work with the engineers who own each codebase, fitting in with their patterns and pipelines rather than parachuting in something nobody else can maintain.
Keep up as models, tools and providers change, and choose pragmatically on quality, cost and latency rather than habit.
Share what you learn with engineers around you through code, examples and conversation.
Work with product managers, product owners and subject matter experts to understand the business problem properly, because the best prompt cannot rescue a misunderstood requirement.

Systems, Tools and Technology

C# .NET (primary development language)
Large language model APIs across multiple providers
AI coding tools: GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents
Prompt engineering and context design patterns
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings (desirable)
Evaluation frameworks and automated quality pipelines for AI outputs

Technical and Professional Expertise

Solid production experience with C# .NET, including working in established codebases you did not write, and shipping changes into them safely.
Hands-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, context engineering and structured outputs, in real work rather than tutorials.
A track record of shipping quickly, with examples of taking something from idea to working software in weeks rather than quarters.
Experience testing or evaluating LLM outputs in some structured way, and using the results to improve quality.
Daily fluency with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalents.

Core Responsibilities And Contributions

Deliver AI features end-to-end: from requirement understanding through to shipped, evaluated product capability.

Tracebit is a $20M Series A London cybersecurity startup backed by FirstMark and Accel that builds cloud intrusion detection using canaries. Their decoy tripwire technology protects major organizations like Riot Games, Docker, and Snyk, recently gaining acclaim for discovering a critical P1 security flaw in Google's Gemini CLI.

As a Founding Engineer at Tracebit, you will join an elite team building honeytoken-based security tools. Reporting to the Engineering Lead, you will ship production code daily across the full stack while utilizing cutting-edge AI development tools. This role offers unparalleled learning velocity and founder exposure in a high-growth, office-based environment.

Location

London, UK

Why this role is remarkable

Join a high-growth startup that just raised a $20M Series A led by FirstMark and Accel to redefine cloud security.
Unparalleled learning velocity with founder-level exposure and the chance to influence a product already trusted by global tech giants.
Work in a high-talent environment that recently discovered a P1 security flaw in Google’s Gemini CLI, ensuring your work has global impact.

What You Will Do

Build and deploy decoy tripwires using C# on .NET Core 10, Terraform, and HTMX to detect advanced cloud intrusions.
Collaborate directly with the CTO and Engineering Lead to ship customer-facing features daily with minimal bureaucracy or process.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools like Claude and Codex to accelerate your engineering output and solve complex architectural challenges.

The ideal candidate

Strong academic foundation with a degree in a STEM subject like Computer Science or Physics and a track record of excellence.
Proven ability to write clean, correct code in a known language with a deep curiosity for how systems function.
Demonstrated passion for building through side projects, open-source contributions, or hackathons, showing a clear bias for action and delivery.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Impactive IT is recruiting for a hybrid Scrum Master / .NET Developer to support an organisation going through a significant change in how its development teams operate. The majority of this role will be focused on Scrum Master responsibilities, overseeing two development teams initially, potentially increasing to three.

They need someone who can bring structure, visibility and discipline to the teams. That includes making sure work is properly captured, developers are keeping tasks updated and the business has a clear understanding of capacity, progress and potential delivery issues.

This isn’t a role for someone who simply runs the ceremonies and updates a board. They want a genuine go-getter someone who gets out into the business, speaks to people, asks questions and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be told what needs doing. This will be a Scrum Master first, Developer second position.

You’ll be responsible for:
✅ Leading stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives across two or potentially three teams
✅ Improving delivery discipline, work-item updates and visibility of team capacity
✅ Identifying blockers, risks and dependencies before they begin affecting delivery
✅ Working with Product Owners and stakeholders to create, structure and prioritise backlogs
✅ Setting up separate team or workstream backlogs as the organisation moves towards smaller, focused teams
✅ Supporting the migration or reconfiguration of delivery processes across Azure DevOps and Jira
✅ Helping the business transition towards a Product Operating Model
✅ Advising how products, workstreams and team responsibilities should be structured as the model develops
✅ Contributing to hands-on .NET / ASP.NET development when required
✅ Supporting code reviews, deployment pipelines and wider engineering best practices

jobs.title: CRM Peppermint Dynamics Developer
jobs.description:
Ampa
, one of the UK's leading professional services organisations, is looking for an exceptional CRM/Peppermint Developer
to join the team on an initial 12-month FTC
.

As part of the continued evolution of our IT organisation, this role introduces specialist CRM capability into the Applications & Development team. The role will undertake a detailed assessment of the current Peppermint Dynamics CRM platform, including all customisations, integrations, and supporting processes, and lead the redesign, refactoring, and rebuilding of components where necessary. The objective is to establish a modern, supportable, and strategically aligned CRM platform and support its successful relaunch across the business.

What you will be doing:

Responsible for providing design and development expertise for the firm's Peppermint Dynamics CRM platform as part of a strategic modernisation programme. The role will lead the redevelopment of existing CRM capabilities into a new environment, refactoring bespoke functionality, rebuilding solutions where source code is unavailable, restoring standard Dynamics relationships, and delivering the migration of business-critical data.

Working within Agile delivery teams, the role will ensure solutions align with Microsoft Dynamics and Peppermint best practices, reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and provide a robust foundation for future business growth and client relationship management capabilities. The role will work closely with internal CMS specialists to support integration and alignment with the firm's Unified CMS platform.

The immediate priorities are:

Becoming familiar with the Peppermint Dynamics CRM platform, customisations and integrated solutions, backlogs and current roadmaps as well as the supported business processes.
Participate in Agile Ceremonies.

Key accountabilities:

Act as the go-to contact for the technical design, development and support of the firm's Peppermint Dynamics CRM platform.
Designing, creating, testing and problem solving of workflows, data entry and retrieval screens.
Documenting all work in accordance with agreed standards (including DevOps, ServiceNow, etc).
Analyse existing CRM customisations, identifying functionality requiring redevelopment where source code is unavailable, unsupported or no longer aligned with platform best practice.
Design, develop and refactor bespoke Peppermint CRM and Microsoft Dynamics solutions, ensuring scalability, maintainability and adherence to architectural standards.
Restore and optimise standard Dynamics entity relationships and data structures that have been modified or compromised over time.
Lead the technical migration of CRM data into the new environment, ensuring data quality, consistency and business continuity.
Work closely with internal CMS subject matter experts to ensure alignment and integration between CRM and the firm's Unified Case Management platform.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust and sustainable technical solutions.
Support DevOps, change and release management processes, ensuring controlled deployment of solutions across all environments.
Conduct code reviews, technical design reviews and solution assurance activities.
Provide expert 3rd line support for complex Peppermint CRM issues and identify opportunities for platform optimisation and technical debt reduction.

What you will need:

A minimum of 3 years demonstrable track record of working as Developer.

You will need to have previous experience with the below tech stack:

Strong Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Peppermint CRM development experience.
Strong understanding of Dynamics data models, entity relationships and platform architecture.
Expertise in C#, .NET, Power Platform, Dataverse, APIs and integration technologies.
Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
Experience refactoring legacy solutions and reducing technical debt.
Experience delivering CRM migration and transformation programmes.

Experience with the following would be beneficial:

MS SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS , T-SQL, Azure SQL Server.
Experience within legal, professional services or regulated environments.

Key competencies:

The ability to produce high quality technical material, and to identify and develop opportunities to provide business benefit.
Strong operational experience with an analytical skillset to assess, identify and exploit opportunities.
Excellent organisation and the ability to prioritise and carry out multiple tasks.
Strong problem solving abilities with the ability to think ahead and anticipate problems, issues, and solutions.
The ability to build good relationships with clients/operational managers and colleagues.

Benefits, Agile Working And Additional Information

We embrace agile working and offer a blended approach to where and how we work.

We appreciate that people have different needs and preferences and we’re keen to be flexible, after all, we value what you do, not where you do it.

We have the following hubs across the UK: Birmingham, Bristol, Edinburgh, Leeds, Leicester, Lincoln, London, Manchester, Milton Keynes, Nottingham, Sheffield, Stratford upon Avon and in the South East; Brighton, Chichester, Crawley, East Grinstead, Eastbourne, Lewes, Seaford, Storrington, Southampton & Tunbridge Wells.

jobs.title: Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are looking for a candidate who will be part of the Architecture team within the EY Client Technology’s Technology Strategy and Architecture (TS&A) function. The candidate will be responsible for defining and delivering architectures and designs for business-critical global products and platforms, hosted in a variety of infrastructure/environments considering reusability, scalability and reliability in alignment with EY’s mission and strategy!

Your Key Responsibilities

Build relationships across the business to understand their requirements, strategy and help them build product/platform roadmaps, demonstrate architecture leadership to translate business requirements into architecture blueprints, as well as innovative and practical design (both high and low level).
Own the overall technology, architecture and design landscape of the product/platform from solutioning to delivery to adoption and sale phases.
Potentially lead a team of architects in a portfolio or large product, set the overall technology and architecture direction and own its end-to-end delivery in a lead architect’s capacity, along with providing constant architecture governance and guidance.
Solve complex problems in realms where solutions may not currently exist, necessitating the ideation and incubation of the new solutions/ways of working/technologies, technical feasibility and buy/build analysis, vendor product evaluations, proof of concepts (with hands-on) and presenting various options to the business with appropriate recommendations.
Work very closely with multi-disciplinary teams (e.g. engineering, platform, infosec) to deliver the envisioned architectures and design using optimized delivery approaches, in compliance to enterprise standards, practices, policies and guidelines.
Provide leadership in product delivery to build and consume reusable functional and technical assets. Identify, define and implement the reusable assets and standards.
Provide support to product and project managers in building the plans, forecast, estimations and costs for new as well as existing products/platforms, to build the appropriate balance between costs, risks and quality.
Provides coaching, mentoring and support to development teams during the delivery phase across the eco-system, frameworks and platforms. Ensure that the developed artifacts comply to envisioned architecture and design, expected quality, recommended standards/practices with code reviews and various levels of architecture, design and quality reviews.
Contribute to architecture and development standards/guidelines to promote optimization and consistency.
Have the ability to work across multiple projects with varied stakeholders. An architect sets architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts providing technical leadership and advisory services to the business. He/she anticipates needs and potential objections and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants.
Demonstrate good interpersonal communication and organizational skills that are required to operate as a leading member of global, distributed teams that deliver quality services and solutions.
Cultivate lasting relationships across business, IT and vendors / industry analysts to maintain insight into the broader enterprise as well as industry trends. Understand new trends and emerging technologies, and how they apply to EY. Evangelize and encourage the importance of technical quality, emerging technologies, sharing & experimentation across the org through mentoring, hackathons, communities etc

Skills And Attributes For Success

Led and governed a global team of solution architects and technical architects, driving the technology and architecture landscape of large and complex portfolio of products/solutions/projects, achieving success in its implementation and adoption.
Architecture leadership skills, advanced understanding and practical experience of architecture role with proven track record in a complex, large-scale (team size in hundreds), global product/platform (user base in hundreds, thousands and more) ecosystem across the entire lifecycle from planning to delivery to support/operations and adoption. Proven ability to work with business as well as perform hands-on technology delivery work in architect’s capacity using various architecture and design tools.
Hands-on deep experience of one or more specialization of solution and technical architecture role e.g. application, infrastructure/cloud, integration, data and security architectures and successful delivery of functional as well as non-functional aspects of a product/platform, using native cloud, full-stack application, data, security, AI technologies, following Agile, DevSecOps and automation practices.
Expert-level skills in defining, designing and developing distributed and scalable products and platforms, using reusable domain-specific composable (micro) services running on containers on multi-platform/hybrid clouds (Microsoft Azure preferred) using the respective cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services.
Expert-level skills in multiple application programming and scripting languages (JavaScript, .NET, Java, Python, C++, etc), SQL and noSQL databases, Bigdata and its processing, Data analytics and Machine Learning, Industry’s recommended authentication/authorization technologies. Microsoft and Azure based technology skills are preferred.
Ability to adopt and relate new technologies to the set of problems we face at EY while adhering to security and other EY standards.
Understanding of business and organizational strategy and ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to business partners effectively and comprehensibly.
In-depth knowledge of various design patterns, and architectural styles (e.g., traditional application based as well as microservices and containers, event-driven, data streaming, data transformations and analytics)
Strong collaboration, analytical, interpersonal and communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics.
15+ years overall IT industry experience, with 5+ years in a solution or technical architect role using service and hosting solutions such as private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS and SaaS platforms.
Achieved one or more of the typical solution and technical architecture certifications e.g. Microsoft, MS Azure Certification, TOGAF, AWS Cloud Certified, Pivotal, CISSIP, Zachman, ITIL, Cisco, (ISC)2, CEH, SAFe, PMI, and SAP etc
Thought leadership - presenting ideas, products, concept papers to varied audiences, building point of views and presenting them in industry forums/event.
Experience in designing and implementation of business use-cases using low-code/no-code, Generative AI, data reporting, data management and governance technologies, mobile applications, deep cloud security concepts.

What We Look For

We want people who are self-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members which means you may need to work outside of the normal working hours in your time zone to partner with other Client Technology staff globally. Some travel may also be required, both domestic and international.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer You (Canada)

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $165,800 to $302,300. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Role: Senior Solution Architect
Day Rate: £680 per day (Inside IR35)
Location:2 days per week on-site
Clearance: Active SC Cleared clearance required
Contract Length: 6 months initial contract

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Solution Architect

to join one of our Government Clients across a technology platform design project.

You will own and define the target state architecture, driving technology modernisation across an estate that combines legacy .NET services, modern cloud-native components, identity and security platforms, and AWS managed data services.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Design Authority: Produce HLDs/LLDs, ADRs, and NFRs; govern design approvals via ARBs and CABs.
Modernisation Roadmap: Define migration paths to retire legacy tech (.NET WPF, Terraform tech debt, dual Vue.js/React footprint).
Cloud and Security: Design scalable patterns using AWS Well-Architected principles, Docker containerisation, and identity tools
Data Architecture: Oversee logical/physical data across PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch with a focus on data minimisation and security

Essential

Key Requirements

10+ years in software engineering/architecture, with 3+ years as a Solution/Technical Architect on complex platforms.
Active SC Clearance
Proven experience in technology modernisation and legacy-to-cloud migration paths.
Core tech stack: .NET / .NET Core, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript (Vue.js, React).
AWS Managed Services (RDS, SQS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, ECR) and AWS Well-Architected Framework.
Terraform (IaC) and Docker at scale.
Identity, authentication, and API Gateway platforms (e.g. WSO2, RADIUS).
Background in regulated, security-conscious, or public sector environments.

Desirable

TOGAF or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional).
AWS SageMaker or ML/analytics tooling.

£650.00 - £680.00 / day

Job Description

Applications Architect

Hampshire (site-based)

We're looking for an experienced Applications Architect to join our Digital Applications Transformation team. This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in complex transformation programmes. We’re passionate about building diverse, inclusive teams and actively encourage applications from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates, with support and adjustments available throughout the hiring process.

You'll work at the heart of major business and technology change initiatives, partnering with architects, engineers and business leaders to design solutions that deliver real value. Whether you're helping modernise core mainframe platforms, defining enterprise-wide architecture roadmaps, or guiding development teams through delivery, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our clients' technology ecosystems. The Solution Architect is responsible for designing and delivering end-to-end technical solutions aligned with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards. The role bridges the gap between business needs and technology, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions that support digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

EDRMS & Enterprise Content Management

Support integrated search capabilities and bespoke application components developed primarily in Java.
Ensure the secure deployment, maintenance, and enhancement of document and records management platforms.

Client-Side Application Management

Support both COTS and GOTS applications, including:

Analysis toolsets

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Banyan Software provides the best permanent home for successful enterprise software companies, their employees, and customers. We are on a mission to acquire, build and grow great enterprise software businesses all over the world that have dominant positions in niche vertical markets. In recent years, Banyan was named the #1 fastest-growing private software company in the US on the Inc. 5000 and amongst the top 10 fastest-growing companies by the Deloitte Technology Fast 500. Founded in 2016 with a permanent capital base setup to preserve the legacy of founders, Banyan focuses on a buy and hold for life strategy for growing software companies that serve specialized vertical markets.
Overview
We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices
, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.
Key Responsibilities
Application Modernization Execution:

Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling:

Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.

Consultative Engineering & Change Management:

Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
Hands-on Software Development:

Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
Feedback Loop:

Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
Standards & Quality:

Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Experience:

5+ years
of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
Full Stack Proficiency:

Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
Cloud Native & IaC:

Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
Consulting & Change Management:

Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
DevSecOps & CI/CD:

Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
Architectural Understanding:

Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Communication & Interpersonal Skills:

Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)
Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering
is the team that builds and supports the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences
. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About The Role

We’re looking for a product-focused Software Engineer II
to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools
. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally.

We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a remote-first working model
with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in Oxford.

What You’ll Do

Drive Impact: Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.
Shape the Product: Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.
Collaborate & Mentor: Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.
Innovate with AI: Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.
Champion Operational Health: Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.
Build for Quality: Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.

Skills & Experience

We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.

Full-Stack Mindset: Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.
Problem Solving: A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.
Data-Driven: A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.
AI Coding: you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code.
Global Mindset: Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.

We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively.

We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our coding interview exercises
in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!

What We Offer

Competitive compensation packages, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveller first: We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
Execution is our edge: We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
We succeed together: The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

Discover more in our Tech Blog, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.

Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our ED&I strategy shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com
.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com
. We have all the answers!

rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD dla aplikacji w Javie, .NET i Node.js/TypeScripcie,

automatyzacja instalacji i aktualizacji produktu, również w środowiskach klientów,
konfiguracja i rozwój monitoringu, zbierania logów oraz alertowania,
rozbudowa pipeline’ów o bramki jakościowe: analizę SonarQube, testy automatyczne i skanowanie zależności,
zarządzanie konfiguracją i sekretami aplikacji w sposób bezpieczny dla środowisk produkcyjnych,

minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze CI/CD i automatyzacji dostarczania oprogramowania,
praktyczna znajomość Dockera: budowanie i optymalizacja obrazów, sieci, wolumeny, diagnostyka,
doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetesem w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz umiejętność diagnozowania problemów z uruchamianiem i wydajnością aplikacji w klastrze,
znajomość Helma na poziomie tworzenia i utrzymania własnych chartów,
umiejętność pisania idempotentnych playbooków i ról w Ansible,
doświadczenie z Jenkinsem i GitHub Actions w modelu pipeline as code,
swobodna praca z Gitem i SonarQube w zespole deweloperskim,
znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i analizy logów; naszym standardem są Prometheus, Grafana oraz Loki lub Graylog,
dobra znajomość systemu Linux oraz umiejętność pisania skryptów w Bashu,
język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2, ponieważ pracujemy w środowisku międzynarodowym.

doświadczenie operacyjne z bazami PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra lub Solr,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w pracy inżynierskiej, w tym GitHub Copilot oraz rozwiązań opartych o modele językowe,
certyfikaty potwierdzające kompetencje w obszarze DevOps.

Pracę przy rozwoju produktów, a nie w obszarze utrzymania zgłoszeń,

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Service Delivery/IX Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Engineer
to join our global IX Platform team, where innovation knows no borders. This role is part of a larger transition and a dedicated team being created in Kraków. This team designs, builds, and evolves modern cloud-native backend services and distributed architectures that power mission-critical travel and airline technology solutions worldwide. By delivering high-availability systems, robust APIs, and scalable data flows, the team enables travel disruptors and established leaders to retail, distribute, and fulfill travel at scale. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity, and commitment so we can all win together.

As an Engineer on the IX Platform team in Kraków, you will build and support resilient microservices, messaging patterns, and cloud-native backend components. You will collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Delivery teams to translate platform vision into production-ready software. Takes ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support. This role demands strong backend engineering fundamentals, a commitment to clean code, and constructive problem-solving to maintain high reliability across enterprise distributed systems.

What You'll Do

Service Lifecycle: Take ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
Backend Engineering: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and modern JDK capabilities.
API Development: Build, consume, and document secure, well-structured RESTful and SOAP APIs and integration services for high-availability systems.
Cloud Operations: Deploy and operate containerized microservices in cloud environments, focusing on Google Cloud Platform, GKE, Cloud Run, and automated deployment patterns.
Distributed Systems: Implement asynchronous, event-driven communication patterns using messaging technologies, queues, and event streams.
Data Management: Optimize relational database schemas, SQL queries, transactions, caching mechanisms, and data access layers for consistency and scale.
Quality & Code Health: Author production-quality code with unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and drive continuous engineering improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to refine technical requirements, evaluate design trade-offs, and support operational readiness through logging, monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Java backend development, modern JDK versions, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and performance tuning.
Proven experience designing, developing, consuming, and maintaining REST and SOAP APIs, including API security, contracts, and versioning.
Practical experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform services.
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, service discovery, resiliency, messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and key resilience/consistency mechanisms including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, consistency, latency, and failure handling.
Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL schema design, query optimization, data modeling, and modern CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar Java backend frameworks.
Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, or Cloud Build.
Experience with Kafka or high-volume event streaming platforms.
Experience designing systems for high availability, horizontal scaling, disaster recovery, and performance under load.
Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, enterprise identity integrations, or NoSQL/caching technologies like PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Helm.
Domain experience in travel, airline, retailing, distribution, booking, or fulfillment enterprise systems.

Work arrangements

Hybrid working mode; 3 chosen days from the office in a week
Flexible working hours: Maintain your work-life balance by adjusting your working hours to your needs

Paid time off

Year-End-Break: enjoy additional fully paid days off during the last week of the year
Paid parental leave: Take up to 12 weeks off with pay after birth or adoption of a child. Sabre Global Paid Parental Leave runs concurrently with local leave policies.

Your money

Say Thanks program: collect points on recognition program and transfer them to wide variety of gifts and services

Health and wellness

Foreign travel insurance: feel safe going abroad with free Allianz insurance offered as part of our Lux Med package
Employee Assistance Program: find help in free, confidential program with a certified counselor
Mindfulness & meditation apps: take care of your mental and physical health
Life insurance: sign up for free, high coverage life insurance program

Career development

Professional development: access to e-learning platforms as well as join Sabre live learning sessions
Certification and tuition reimbursement
Our Communities: join one of our team member groups focused on sharing knowledge and best practices (Google Developers Group, Innovation Lab Community, Women in Technology, SOLVE!T and many more)

And more

At EY, we’re all in shape to your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

The opportunity

The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross-functional business teams such as Clients & Industries (C&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.

The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data-driven and AI-enabled future.

The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.

Your key responsibilities

Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target-state architecture.
Develop future-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
Assess the current landscape and define transition-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
Identify cross-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision-making.
Translate strategic business needs into end-to-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long-term sustainability.
Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
Promote API-first, event-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade-offs in clear, business-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.

Att jobba som Senior .NET utvecklare

Vi söker en senior .NET utvecklare som vill bli en del av ett team som bygger och utvecklar affärskritiska system inom försäkringsområdet. Du kommer att arbeta nära mjukvaruarkitekter, produktägare, testare och andra utvecklare för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla högkvalitativa lösningar som är säkra, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara.

Tillsammans med teamet deltar du i arbete kring krav, design och systemarkitektur och bidrar till välgrundade tekniska beslut. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i .NET/C#, samtidigt som du även kommer att arbeta med och vidareutveckla interna frontendlösningar i React.

Utvecklingsarbetet sker i en eventdriven arkitektur inom en säkerhetskritisk miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och stabilitet. Du arbetar med integrationer mot andra system och deltar aktivt i det kontinuerliga arbetet med att förbättra kodkvalitet, tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

Vi söker dig som är svensktalande och trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och driftsstabila system står i fokus. Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och uppskattar att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett teamorienterat arbetssätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kompetens och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och de tekniska plattformarna.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och intresserad av att ligga i framkant, exempelvis inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, och ser värdet i verktyg som GitHub Copilot för att skapa ännu bättre lösningar.

Systemutveckling i C# och .NET
Backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar, gärna NServiceBus eller RabbitMQ
Utveckling av RESTful API:er
Relationsdatabaser, gärna SQL Server, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core
Git och moderna CI/CD-flöden

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Madelene Skogh på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare – API & tekniskt ledarskap
jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du fortsätta vara hands-on i utvecklingen, men samtidigt få större möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och hur API-utvecklingen ska bedrivas?

Vi söker en senior .NET-utvecklare till ett mindre utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att modernisera en etablerad produkt (Lönessystemet POL). Fokus ligger på att utveckla API:er i C#/.NET med Kubernetes i en miljö där ny teknik möter befintlig arkitektur, kod och data.

Du kommer in i ett läge där det finns mycket att påverka. En del handlar om att bygga nytt, en annan om att förstå vad som redan finns och avgöra vad som ska behållas, förändras eller byggas om.

Teamet är litet och du kommer in som en nyckelperson från start. Med din seniora API-kompetens kliver du rakt in i de tekniska diskussionerna tillsammans med övriga seniora kollegor och får möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och vägval direkt. Här är det kort väg mellan idé och beslut och du får stort utrymme att förändra och förbättra. Du är samtidigt en del av det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet – det här är tekniskt ledarskap, inte personalansvar.

Vi använder givetvis AI som ett naturligt verktyg inom utvecklingen, men söker hela tiden nästa steg inom agentbaserad utveckling, som kan användas för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och lösningar.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du framför allt att:

Designa och utveckla moderna API:er i C#/.NET i en Kubernetes-baserad miljö.
Vara med och modernisera vår befintliga produkt med dess legacylösningar och göra tekniska vägval för hur de ska utvecklas vidare.
Ta ansvar för API-lösningen hela vägen från design och implementation men även vara djupt delaktig i hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Vägleda andra utvecklare och vara ett stöd i tekniska diskussioner och vägval.
Ansvara för designfrågor kring bland annat idempotency, atomicity och concurrency.
Sätta dig in i befintlig kod, datamodeller och stored procedures och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas och vad som behöver förändras.
Samarbeta med DevOps- och infrastrukturkompetenser kring drift och deployment.
Bidra till och driva utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt, bland annat inom AI och agentbaserad utveckling.

Vi tror på värdet av att träffas och arbeta tillsammans på plats. Det skapar både ett effektivt arbetssätt och ett nära samarbete i teamet. Därför ser vi gärna att du är på vårt kontor i Solna 2–3 dagar i veckan.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och som är van att arbeta med API:er i komplexa systemmiljöer. För den här rollen är det särskilt viktigt att du har erfarenhet av API:er som skapar och uppdaterar verksamhetskritiska data.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Mycket god erfarenhet av C#/.NET och API-utveckling, inklusive design och implementation av API:er för create- och update-operationer.
God förståelse för robust API-design, exempelvis concurrency, idempotency, retries, atomicity, transaktioner och datakonsistens.
Erfarenhet av lösningar där flera beroende databasändringar behöver genomföras tillsammans eller rullas tillbaka vid fel.
Erfarenhet av att integrera moderna API-lösningar med legacysystem och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas, behöver refaktoreras eller byggas om.
Förståelse för API:ets hela livscykel, inklusive containers, hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Förmåga att göra välgrundade tekniska och arkitekturella vägval och förankra dem i teamet.
Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar och vägleda andra utvecklare, samtidigt som du själv arbetar hands-on.
Svenska i tal och skrift på professionell nivå.

Det är mycket meriterande om du har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och är van att deploya och drifta containeriserade applikationer. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, kubectl, YAML och Helm är särskilt relevant för vår miljö.

Erfarenhet av Azure, tekniskt arkitekturarbete, API- och applikationssäkerhet eller AI-assisterad/agentbaserad utveckling är meriterande.

Eftersom vi är ett litet team lägger vi stor vikt vid hur du fungerar tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som delar med dig av det du kan och samtidigt är öppen för andras perspektiv. jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare – från backend till frontend
jobs.description:
Fullstackutvecklare med .NET i grunden

Vill du fortsätta utvecklas – utan att behöva välja mellan backend och frontend?

På Nexer söker vi kontinuerligt erfarna fullstackutvecklare till våra kunduppdrag i Göteborgsområdet. Vi söker dig som har .NET som en naturlig grund, men som gärna rör dig över hela stacken och tycker om att förstå lösningen som helhet.

Som konsult hos oss kan du arbeta med allt från produktutveckling och digitala tjänster till integrationsplattformar och affärskritiska verksamhetssystem. Våra kunder finns inom flera olika branscher, både i privat och offentlig sektor.

Gemensamt för uppdragen är att vi söker utvecklare som vill mer än att bara lösa nästa ticket. Du gillar att förstå problemet, diskutera lösningen och vara med och påverka hur den faktiskt byggs.

Vad du kan komma att arbeta med

Uppdragen ser olika ut beroende på kund, men ofta handlar det om att:

utveckla API, tjänster och backendlösningar med C# och .NET
bygga moderna webbapplikationer med exempelvis React, Angular, Vue eller Blazor
designa och utveckla integrationer mellan system och tjänster
arbeta med databaser, säkerhet, autentisering och behörighet
utveckla och driftsätta lösningar i Azure eller andra molnmiljöer
arbeta med Docker, Kubernetes och moderna CI/CD-flöden
diskutera arkitektur och tekniska vägval tillsammans med team och kund

Exakt vilka tekniker du arbetar med kommer att variera mellan uppdragen. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och kan sätta dig in i nya problem än att du kan bocka av varje teknik i en lista.

AI har blivit en del av utvecklarens verktygslåda

AI kommer att fortsätta förändra hur vi utvecklar mjukvara – och söker därför dig som redan har börjat använda AI som en naturlig del av ditt arbete.

Du kanske använder GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude eller liknande verktyg för att utveckla, analysera, felsöka, testa eller dokumentera kod. Det viktiga är inte vilket verktyg du använder, utan att du har börjat hitta sätt att arbeta smartare med hjälp av AI och samtidigt kan bedöma kvaliteten på det som faktiskt produceras.

Har du dessutom börjat experimentera med AI-agenter, agentiska arbetsflöden, MCP eller egna verktyg och integrationer är det extra intressant. Du behöver inte vara AI-specialist – men vi gillar utvecklare som är nyfikna på vart utvecklingen är på väg och gärna testar själva.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av systemutveckling
och som känner dig trygg i rollen som utvecklare.

Du har:

flera års erfarenhet av C# och .NET
erfarenhet av minst ett modernt frontendramverk
arbetat i agila utvecklingsteam och är van att samarbeta med andra utvecklare, testare och verksamhet
förståelse för API, databaser, integrationer och moderna systemarkitekturer
erfarenhet av att använda AI-verktyg i ditt arbete som utvecklare
mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Som konsult behöver du också trivas med att komma in i nya sammanhang, lära känna en ny verksamhet och kunna diskutera både problem och lösningar med kunden.

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det gör ingen. Men efter några år i yrket har du förmodligen hunnit bli riktigt bra på vissa saker – och samtidigt upptäckt hur mycket mer det finns kvar att lära sig.

Extra intressant är det om du har erfarenhet av

Azure eller andra molnplattformar
Docker och Kubernetes
Clean Architecture, DDD eller liknande arkitekturmönster
eventdrivna och distribuerade system
säkerhet, autentisering och Entra ID/OAuth2/OIDC
tekniskt ledarskap eller att driva arkitektur- och designfrågor
att bygga lösningar där AI, LLM eller AI-agenter är en del av själva applikationen

Varför Nexer?

Hos oss får du variationen och utvecklingsmöjligheterna i konsultrollen, men med tryggheten i en anställning och ett team bakom dig.

Vi har kunder inom många olika branscher och långsiktiga samarbeten som ger möjlighet att hitta uppdrag där både din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner kommer till sin rätt.

Du får kollektivavtal och bra villkor, möjlighet till kompetensutveckling, extra semesterdagar, förmånsportal och en arbetsplats där vi tycker att balans mellan jobb och fritid faktiskt ska betyda något.

Men kanske viktigast: du får kollegor som gillar teknik, delar med sig av det de kan och fortfarande är nyfikna på det de inte kan.

Intresserad?

Skicka in din ansökan via formuläret. Har du frågor om rollen eller hur det är att arbeta som konsult hos oss är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Casper Enhörning, på casper.enhorning nexergroup.com.

Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via e-post.
